intelligence.human_view: Think of it like this: a stranger answers fifteen questions and walks away with a whole set of pages — their About, their Skills, their doors — already built, already named, already revealed. The questions are not blank boxes; they are filled in as Naya, as an example, with an Edit button and a voice on every slide explaining what to do. The whole thing sits in the same beautiful frame as everything else, the report lives where the team actually looks, and the order is plain: fix the locks first, prove the front door, prove one whole journey, then grow. And the mind running all of it pauses first and asks: is this right, is it needed, is it mine, is now the time, can I prove it.
intelligence.simple_view: Answer the questions and the walk builds your pages for you! The boxes already have answers in them, written as Naya, and you just click edit to make them yours! You can talk your answers, or have your AI write them, or just skip! Naya talks to you on every slide! Then you get EIGHT doors to open — your Personal, your Business, your World, the Hub, the Dashboard, the Calendar, your About, your Skills! And a wise Naya always thinks first, before she does anything!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — you answer a few questions, dear, and the walk builds your pages for you, whole and beautiful, in the same pretty frame as everything else! The boxes are already filled in as an example, love, so you are never staring at a blank page, and Naya's voice walks you through every step! Then you get eight doors to open, dear, one for each part of your world! And the wise one thinks before she acts, love — she checks that it is right for everyone, and she shows her work, so you can trust what you see!
